| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Highlights |
|------------|--------------|------------|
| **Sushi Gen** | Little Tokyo | Classic omakase, fresh fish, intimate setting |
| **Nobu Los Angeles** | Beverly Hills | Fusion style, celebrity clientele, upscale vibe |
| **KazuNori** | West Hollywood | Creative rolls, excellent service, great value |
| **Sushi Tetsu** | Downtown | Small, family‑run, meticulous preparation |
| **Matsuhisa** | West Hollywood | Chef Nobu’s flagship, high‑end experience |
